testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.trustweave.CredentialSuspensionTest

testcase.name: a reinstatement that did not clear the bit leaves the credential on hold()
a revoked credential cannot be reduced to a hold()
only a credential on hold can be reinstated()
the hold is published before it is recorded()
a credential stays on hold when the hold cannot be cleared()
a missing credential is reported rather than silently ignored()
an active credential can be placed on hold()
a credential is left active when the hold cannot be published()
a credential with no status list is held locally rather than refused()
a credential that expired while on hold is not resurrected()
a credential already on hold is not suspended twice()
an expired credential cannot be held()
a hold that did not actually reach the list is reported, not recorded()
a revoked credential cannot be reinstated()
a hold can be lifted, which is the whole point of it()
